lethalbreed.command.plague.cannot_infect: %s cannot be infected (a zombie, or contamination is disabled).
lethalbreed.notice.config_problems: %s problem(s) in the structure of config/oas/lethalbreed.json:
lethalbreed.notice.unknown_ambiguous: '%s' — did you mean '%s'? Too ambiguous to repair on its own.
lethalbreed.notice.duplicated: '%s' is written in two categories — only one copy is read.
lethalbreed.option.tickBuckets.desc: Stagger buckets for the tick scheduler (zombies/N updated per tick).
lethalbreed.option.autoScaleBuckets.desc: Pick bucket count from population automatically (overrides Tick Buckets).
lethalbreed.option.autoScaleBucketLoad.d: Target zombies processed per tick when auto-scaling.
lethalbreed.option.aiTickBudget.desc: Max full AI updates per tick (0 = unlimited).
lethalbreed.option.spatialCellSize.desc: Spatial hash cell size in blocks (XZ).
Max vertical distance for neighbour/sound queries (0 = ignore Y).
lethalbreed.option.lodLow.desc: Distance for minimal AI; beyond it zombies stop ticking.
lethalbreed.option.lodHysteresis.desc: Slack (blocks) before a zombie downgrades LOD tier (anti-flip).
lethalbreed.option.lodHardFreezeRadius.d: Beyond this from any player, freeze without reclassifying (0 = off).
lethalbreed.option.frozenReclassifyDivis: Frozen zombies reclassify 1 tick in N (higher = cheaper idle crowds).
lethalbreed.option.throttleByLod.desc: Scale AI frequency by distance to save CPU.
Medium-LOD zombies run AI 1 tick in N.
lethalbreed.option.lodLowTickDivisor.des: Low-LOD zombies run AI 1 tick in N.
lethalbreed.option.lodMediumNavMultiplie: Medium-LOD re-paths every Nav Reissue x this.
lethalbreed.option.lodLowNavMultiplier.d: Low-LOD re-paths every Nav Reissue x this.
lethalbreed.option.msptThrottle.desc: Under server lag, temporarily halve AI rate until it recovers.
lethalbreed.option.msptThrottleThreshold: Server MSPT (ms) above which throttling kicks in.
lethalbreed.option.useGpu.desc: Use the GPU solver when available (else CPU).
lethalbreed.option.flowCpuThreads.desc: CPU threads for the flow field (0 = auto).
lethalbreed.option.gpuMinCells.desc: Min grid cells before using GPU (smaller = CPU). 0 = always GPU.
lethalbreed.option.gpuAutoCalibrate.desc: Benchmark CPU vs GPU at boot to auto-pick the threshold.
lethalbreed.option.gpuDeviceIndex.desc: Pick GPU by index (see boot log). -1 = auto.
lethalbreed.option.flowResampleOnMoveDis: Skip recompute until focus moves this far (0 = off).
lethalbreed.option.flowVerticalTolerance: Vertical search window for a surface.
lethalbreed.option.navSpeed.desc: Movement speed when following the flow field.
lethalbreed.option.navYThreshold.desc: A target this many blocks higher makes the zombie walk to the base of its column instead of pressing straight at it.
lethalbreed.option.flowBreakCost.desc: Path cost to break through a block (lower = break more).
lethalbreed.option.flowBuildCost.desc: Path cost to bridge a gap with dirt.
lethalbreed.option.flowOrthoCost.desc: Step cost for straight moves (10 = 1 block). CPU & GPU.
lethalbreed.option.climbThreshold.desc: Build stairs when target is this far above.
lethalbreed.option.climbHorizRadius.desc: Only climb within this distance of the target.
lethalbreed.option.climbGiveUpCooldown.d: Wait before retrying a given-up climb.
lethalbreed.option.pillarMaxHeight.desc: Give up a pillar-up after this many blocks.
lethalbreed.option.pillarJumpPower.desc: Upward velocity of each pillar jump.
lethalbreed.option.targetDetectRadius.de: Detection radius for acquiring a target.
lethalbreed.option.requireLineOfSight.de: Need line of sight to see a target (else heard).
lethalbreed.option.forceNearestTarget.de: Always retarget the nearest living entity.
lethalbreed.option.targetPlayersOnly.des: Only acquire players as targets (ignore villagers, animals, other mobs).
lethalbreed.option.targetMemoryTicks.des: Keep chasing a lost target's last spot (ticks).
lethalbreed.option.targetSwitchMargin.de: Stickiness: a newly-seen target is only adopted if it is closer than the current distance divided by this factor.
lethalbreed.option.failOnAiConflict.desc: Hard-stop if another zombie-AI mod is found.
lethalbreed.option.soundEnabled.desc: Zombies hear and investigate real noise.
lethalbreed.option.soundBaseRadius.desc: Base hearing radius for a normal sound.
lethalbreed.option.soundMoveThreshold.de: Min movement to emit a footstep sound.
lethalbreed.option.soundArriveDistance.d: Distance counted as reaching the source.
lethalbreed.option.varHealthMin.desc: Lower bound of the per-zombie random max-health multiplier.
lethalbreed.option.varHealthMax.desc: Upper bound of the per-zombie random max-health multiplier.
lethalbreed.option.randomEffectEnabled.d: Some zombies carry a random buff for life.
lethalbreed.option.randomEffectChance.de: Fraction of spawns that get an effect.
lethalbreed.option.randomEffectMaxAmplif: Max level of the random effect.
lethalbreed.option.leapEffectPerLevel.de: Extra leap reach per Leap-effect level.
lethalbreed.option.nightSpawnEnabled.des: Master switch for phase-driven hostile spawning. Off means nothing spawns naturally.
lethalbreed.option.onlyPlainZombie.desc: Cancels every other hostile at spawn — skeleton, creeper, husk, drowned, spider and the rest — in every phase.
lethalbreed.option.spawnMaxExtraPasses.d: Safety ceiling on the extra spawn passes per chunk per tick. It is a protection against a runaway tick, not a balance knob.
lethalbreed.option.forceAllZombiesSunBur: All zombie types burn in daylight (incl. husks).
Fire ticks applied on each daylight burn (160 = 8s).
lethalbreed.option.sunImmunePhase.desc: Phase from which zombies stop burning in daylight. Below it they still burn, flee to shade and sleep by day.
lethalbreed.option.leapChance.desc: Chance to leap on an eligible activation.
lethalbreed.option.leapMaxVerticalDiff.d: Max vertical offset (blocks) to the target for a leap to fire.
lethalbreed.option.leapLandingScanDist.d: How far ahead a leap probes for solid ground before committing, so it never jumps into a gap.
How deep below foot level the landing probe looks for ground.
lethalbreed.option.maxBreakHeight.desc: Max vertical blocks a zombie breaks to pass.
lethalbreed.option.floatInWater.desc: Float and swim at the surface instead of sinking.
lethalbreed.option.waterDiveSpeed.desc: Downward speed when diving after a target.
lethalbreed.option.waterSwimSpeed.desc: Horizontal swim speed toward the target.
lethalbreed.option.waterSubmergeOffset.d: How far below the zombie a target must be to count as submerged, which triggers a dive.
lethalbreed.option.waterArriveDistance.d: Horizontal distance to the target at which the swim drive stops pushing.
lethalbreed.option.waterVelocityBlend.de: Swim smoothing: the fraction of the desired velocity blended in each tick, the rest keeping the current one.
lethalbreed.option.waterSurfaceJump.desc: Upward impulse used to hop at the water surface when a solid edge blocks progress.
lethalbreed.option.stuckActivations.desc: Activations of no progress before acting.
Min progress (blocks²) that avoids the stuck counter.
lethalbreed.option.climbJumpMaxAge.desc: Abort a pillar rung that gains no height in this many activations.
lethalbreed.option.descendThreshold.desc: Dig down when target is this far below.
lethalbreed.option.safeDropBlocks.desc: Drops this short are walked, not carved.
lethalbreed.option.preventFallDamage.des: Cancel fall damage for smart zombies.
lethalbreed.option.meleeStopRange.desc: Stop block ops within this range of target.
lethalbreed.option.meleeStopHeight.desc: Max vertical gap for the melee stop.
lethalbreed.option.pillarFinishHeight.de: Vertical distance to the target at which the pillar climb is considered done and the zombie hops off.
lethalbreed.option.pillarFinishSpeed.des: Horizontal speed of the hop off the top of a finished pillar.
lethalbreed.option.pillarFinishJump.desc: Upward impulse of the hop off the top of a finished pillar.
lethalbreed.option.descendDirectlyBelowR: Horizontal distance within which a target counts as directly below, so the zombie digs straight down after it.
Break progress added per tick (/ hardness).
lethalbreed.option.breakGraceTicks.desc: Ticks a break survives without re-request.
lethalbreed.option.breachEnabled.desc: Nearby zombies converge on a single breach column instead of each chipping its own block.
lethalbreed.option.breachRadius.desc: Cluster radius: a zombie about to break joins an existing breach within this range that serves the same target.
lethalbreed.option.maxConcurrentBreaches: How many distinct breach columns one cluster may work at once. 1 means strictly one block at a time.
lethalbreed.option.breachGraceTicks.desc: How long a breach survives with nobody working it before the slot is freed for the next one.
lethalbreed.option.breakConcentrationPer: Speed bonus per extra zombie breaking the same block. Progress is multiplied by 1 + (breakers − 1) × this.
lethalbreed.option.breakConcentrationCap: Hard cap on that concentration bonus, so a large pile of zombies cannot shred blocks instantly.
lethalbreed.option.blockOpsEnabled.desc: Master switch for all breaking/bridging/pillaring (off = pure vanilla pathing).
lethalbreed.option.blockOpsPerTick.desc: Max world edits per tick per dimension.
lethalbreed.option.maxConcurrentBreaks.d: Cap on simultaneous progressive breaks per dimension (anti-TPS-lag).
lethalbreed.option.breakProtectBlockEnti: Never break blocks with a block-entity (chests, furnaces, spawners, beds).
lethalbreed.option.breakDropsItems.desc: Broken blocks drop their items (off = no item-entity spam on raids).
lethalbreed.option.breakMaxHardness.desc: Blocks harder than this are unbreakable.
lethalbreed.option.phaseHpMaxGrowth.desc: Growth rate of the maximum-health multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseHpMinGrowth.desc: Growth rate of the minimum-health multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseHpExponent.desc: Exponent shared by both health curves; above 1 they bend upward.
lethalbreed.option.phaseDmgMaxGrowth.des: Growth rate of the maximum-damage multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseDmgMinGrowth.des: Growth rate of the minimum-damage multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseDmgExponent.desc: Exponent shared by both damage curves.
lethalbreed.option.phaseSpdMaxGrowth.des: Growth rate of the maximum-speed multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseSpdMinGrowth.des: Growth rate of the minimum-speed multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseSpdExponent.desc: Exponent shared by both speed curves.
lethalbreed.option.phaseEffChanceDecay.d: How fast the beneficial-effect roll chance approaches its ceiling. Lower reaches it sooner.
lethalbreed.option.phaseEffCountDecay.de: How fast the number of beneficial effects approaches its ceiling with the phase.
Most beneficial effects a single zombie can be rolled.
lethalbreed.option.phaseEffAmpDecay.desc: How fast the beneficial-effect amplifier approaches its ceiling with the phase.
lethalbreed.option.phaseEffAmpCeiling.de: Highest beneficial-effect amplifier the phase curve may reach, still capped globally by the amplifier ceiling.
lethalbreed.option.phaseMobcapGrowth.des: Growth rate of the night-spawn mob-cap multiplier.
Growth rate of the night-spawn frequency multiplier.
Phases at which the broadcast colour changes. Add or remove entries to add or remove tiers.
lethalbreed.option.phaseMaxEnabled.desc: Enables a hard ceiling on the phase number. Off by default, so the phase climbs without bound.
lethalbreed.option.phaseMax.desc: The ceiling itself, used only when the phase ceiling is enabled.
lethalbreed.option.phaseLoopEnabled.desc: On reaching the ceiling: loop back to phase 1 and climb again, or stay pinned at the ceiling.
lethalbreed.option.phaseDmgCeiling.desc: Ceiling of the damage multiplier curve. It is what stops a zombie from ever one-shotting a player in full armour.
lethalbreed.option.phaseHpCeiling.desc: Ceiling of the maximum-health multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseSpdCeiling.desc: Ceiling of the movement-speed multiplier curve.
lethalbreed.option.phaseMobcapCeiling.de: Ceiling of the mob-cap multiplier. This is a performance bound as much as a balance one — nothing here despawns.
lethalbreed.option.phaseDamageCap.desc: Hardest a zombie may ever hit, before armour. An absolute cap, independent of the curves.
lethalbreed.option.phaseHealthCap.desc: Most health a zombie may ever have. An absolute cap, independent of the curves.
lethalbreed.option.phaseSpeedCap.desc: Fastest a zombie may ever move, including a rolled Speed effect.
lethalbreed.option.specialBaseChance.des: Base chance a spawn is special.
lethalbreed.option.specialShowName.desc: Show the special type as a floating name.
Phase from which the Sprinter can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialSprinterWeight: Relative draw weight of the Sprinter; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
lethalbreed.option.specialLeaperPhase.de: Phase from which the Leaper can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialLeaperWeight.d: Relative draw weight of the Leaper; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberPhase.de: Phase from which the Bomber can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberWeight.d: Relative draw weight of the Bomber; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
Phase from which the Screamer can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialScreamerWeight: Relative draw weight of the Screamer; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
lethalbreed.option.specialHealerPhase.de: Phase from which the Healer can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialHealerWeight.d: Relative draw weight of the Healer; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
lethalbreed.option.specialJuggernautPhas: Phase from which the Juggernaut can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialJuggernautWeig: Relative draw weight of the Juggernaut; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
lethalbreed.option.specialNecromancerPha: Phase from which the Necromancer can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialNecromancerWei: Relative draw weight of the Necromancer; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
Phase from which the Splitter can appear at all.
lethalbreed.option.specialSplitterWeight: Relative draw weight of the Splitter; higher is more frequent, 0 means never picked.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberArmRange: Distance to the target at which a Bomber arms and commits to detonating.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberFuseMinT: Shortest fuse, in game ticks — the floor of the random roll made when it arms.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberFuseMaxT: Longest fuse, in game ticks. A long fuse leaves the victim time, and detonates harder for it.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberPowerMin: Explosion power of the shortest fuse. Vanilla TNT is about 4.0.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberPowerMax: Explosion power of the longest fuse — the payoff for having swelled the whole time.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberSplatter: Splatter radius as a multiple of the blast radius. Above 1.0, escaping the blast still leaves you in the gore.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberInfectCh: Contamination chance at full intensity; it scales down linearly as intensity falls.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberBlindThr: Splatter intensity from which Blindness is applied. Set to 1.0 to disable Blindness entirely.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberEffectCo: Most distinct effects one Bomber's gore cocktail can carry.
How fast the cocktail grows toward its ceiling with the phase. Lower reaches the ceiling sooner.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberEffectAm: Highest amplifier the cocktail may roll. Each effect draws uniformly between 0 and this.
How fast the amplifier ceiling grows toward its maximum with the phase.
lethalbreed.option.specialBomberPuddleIn: Whether the lingering gore puddle can also transmit the contamination, once per victim per puddle.
lethalbreed.option.specialScreamerRadius: Radius within which a Screamer hands its target to nearby idle zombies.
lethalbreed.option.specialHealerRadius.d: Radius of the Healer's regeneration aura.
lethalbreed.option.specialHealerRegenTic: How long the Regeneration granted by a Healer lasts.
lethalbreed.option.specialHealerRegenAmp: Amplifier of the Regeneration granted by a Healer. 0 is Regeneration I.
lethalbreed.option.specialNecromancerMin: Fewest children a Necromancer summons per activation.
lethalbreed.option.specialNecromancerMax: Most children a Necromancer summons per activation.
lethalbreed.option.specialNecromancerDen: The summon is skipped when more zombies than this are already inside the density radius.
Radius of the local-density check that gates a Necromancer summon.
lethalbreed.option.specialNecromancerSpr: How far the summoned children are scattered around the Necromancer.
lethalbreed.option.specialSplitterChildr: How many small children a Splitter spawns when it dies.
lethalbreed.option.specialSplitterChildS: Size multiplier of each Splitter child.
lethalbreed.option.specialSplitterSpread: How far the children are scattered when a Splitter dies.
lethalbreed.option.specialSprinterSpeedA: Speed effect amplifier on a Sprinter. 1 is Speed II.
lethalbreed.option.specialSprinterSpeedM: Movement-speed attribute multiplier on a Sprinter, on top of the effect.
Leap effect amplifier on a Leaper. 2 is Leap III.
lethalbreed.option.specialJuggernautResi: Resistance effect amplifier on a Juggernaut. 1 is Resistance II.
Zombie hits can infect with a slow, uncurable-by-milk plague.
lethalbreed.option.contamBaseChance.desc: Base infection chance on a hit.
Fewest in-game days between rolls for latent symptoms to surface.
Most in-game days between rolls for latent symptoms to surface.
lethalbreed.option.contamSymptomMinPct.d: Lowest chance per roll that latent symptoms become visible.
lethalbreed.option.contamSymptomMaxPct.d: Highest chance per roll that latent symptoms become visible.
lethalbreed.option.contamLatentSlowAmoun: Fraction of movement speed removed by the latent slow at infection. It shows no particles.
lethalbreed.option.contamLatentSlowTicks: How long that latent slow lasts. It is deliberately very short.
lethalbreed.option.contamMaxLevel.desc: Highest plague level. Level 1 is the base symptomatic stage.
lethalbreed.option.contamEvolveMinDays.d: Fewest in-game days between rolls to gain the next plague level.
lethalbreed.option.contamEvolveMaxDays.d: Most in-game days between rolls to gain the next plague level.
lethalbreed.option.contamEvolveMinPct.de: Lowest chance per roll to gain the next plague level.
lethalbreed.option.contamEvolveMaxPct.de: Highest chance per roll to gain the next plague level.
lethalbreed.option.contamLevelStep.desc: Intensity added per level: the multiplier is 1 + (level − 1) × step × jitter.
Lowest jitter rolled per victim per level, so no two people follow the same curve.
Highest jitter rolled per victim per level.
lethalbreed.option.contamSlowAmount.desc: Fraction of movement speed removed while a slow episode is active.
lethalbreed.option.contamSlowGapMinSec.d: Shortest gap between slow episodes, measured from the end of one to the start of the next.
lethalbreed.option.contamNoJumpDurMinSec: Shortest a no-jump episode lasts. While active the victim cannot jump at all.
lethalbreed.option.contamWeakAmount.desc: Fraction of attack damage removed while a weak-strike episode is active.
lethalbreed.option.contamHallucDurMinSec: Shortest a hallucination lasts. While active the victim sees every other player as a zombie.
lethalbreed.option.contamReanimateHumano: Dead contaminated humanoids rise as zombies.
lethalbreed.option.contamReanimateMinHei: Minimum hitbox height for a corpse to qualify as a reanimatable humanoid.
lethalbreed.option.contamReanimateMaxWid: Maximum hitbox width for a corpse to qualify as a reanimatable humanoid.
lethalbreed.option.contamReanimateAspect: Minimum height-to-width ratio for a corpse to read as upright and biped-shaped.
lethalbreed.option.contamEpisodeCap.desc: Cap on how much a slow or weak episode may remove, so the victim is never fully frozen or harmless.
lethalbreed.option.contamFoodExhaustionM: Food exhaustion applied per point of plague damage. In vanilla, 4.0 exhaustion costs one food point.
lethalbreed.option.contamDevTimeScale.de: Divides every plague timer. 1.0 = normal; lower values make the contamination progress faster.
lethalbreed.option.moodEnabled.desc: Master switch for celebrate / flee / regen behaviours.
lethalbreed.option.fleeEnabled.desc: A wounded zombie retreats and fires the distress rally scream. Off by default, so a wounded zombie keeps fighting.
lethalbreed.option.fleeHealthFraction.de: Drop below this fraction of max HP (with a threat) to start fleeing.
Reach this fraction of max HP to stop fleeing and regen.
lethalbreed.option.regenAmount.desc: Health restored per heal tick while fleeing/celebrating.
lethalbreed.option.fleeThreatRadius.desc: A damager beyond this many blocks stops counting as a threat.
lethalbreed.option.fleeDistance.desc: How far away the fleer aims its retreat path each step.
lethalbreed.option.fleeGroundGainThresho: Minimum ground a fleer must gain over one activation for the retreat to count as working.
How many failed activations a cornered fleer endures before giving up and turning to fight.
lethalbreed.option.corneredFightTicks.de: Minimum time a zombie fights after a blocked flee, so it does not flicker between fleeing and fighting.
lethalbreed.option.fleeFastThreatGiveUp: Flee — Give Up vs Fast Threat
How many failed activations are endured when the threat is at least as fast, where retreating cannot win.
lethalbreed.option.sunShelterEnabled.des: A burning, low-health zombie breaks off and paths to the nearest shaded block to stop burning.
lethalbreed.option.shelterSearchRadius.d: Horizontal radius searched for a shaded refuge column.
lethalbreed.option.shelterSpeed.desc: Navigation speed multiplier while dashing to shade. It matches the flee sprint.
lethalbreed.option.shelterRetryTicks.des: Ticks before a failed shade search is retried, unless the zombie moved more than 4 blocks. 0 disables the cooldown entirely, restoring a full rescan every activation (including the unbounded case for a zombie stuck in water).
lethalbreed.option.distressDistance.desc: Distance from the threat before the fleer screams for help.
lethalbreed.option.distressRallyRadius.d: Hearing radius of the distress scream (idle zombies rally in).
lethalbreed.option.celebrateRadius.desc: No other prey within this radius = area clear = celebrate.
lethalbreed.option.celebrateTicks.desc: Duration of the arms-up victory pose (40 = 2s).
lethalbreed.option.screamVolume.desc: Volume of both screams (>1 also widens audible range).
lethalbreed.option.victoryPitch.desc: Pitch of the triumphant victory scream (high).
lethalbreed.option.distressPitch.desc: Pitch of the anguished distress scream (low).
lethalbreed.option.daySleepEnabled.desc: A targetless zombie sleeps during the day. Before the sun-immunity phase it first shuffles to shade.
lethalbreed.option.daySleepWakeDelayTick: Reaction lag between a sleeper hearing a sound and actually waking. Damage always wakes it instantly.
lethalbreed.option.daySleepAlertTicks.de: How long a roused day-zombie stays awake and hunts before going back to sleep.
lethalbreed.option.dayAwakePhaseStart.de: Phase from which a growing fraction of zombies stays awake by day. Below it, every targetless zombie sleeps.
lethalbreed.option.dayAwakePhaseSlope.de: How much that awake fraction grows per phase past the start.
lethalbreed.option.expertStepDeadzone.de: Dead zone below which a signed delta quantises to no cardinal step at all.
lethalbreed.option.expertBreakHeightEpsi: Epsilon subtracted before rounding up when deriving a zombie's break height from its hitbox.
Squared-length gate below which a heading counts as degenerate and the facing is left alone.
lethalbreed.option.expertPillarHeadingEp: Divide-by-zero guard on the horizontal heading length during a pillar finish hop.
lethalbreed.option.expertPillarCeilingOf: Height above the head at which a pillar climb probes for a ceiling.
lethalbreed.option.expertPillarSupportHe: Height gained before a pillar climber drops a support block into the cell it just left.
Hard floor for the size and speed variation factor, so an extreme roll cannot make a zombie invisibly small or frozen.
lethalbreed.option.expertMobcapChunkDivi: Vanilla mob-cap divisor, the 17×17-chunk spawn area. Lower means denser natural spawns.
lethalbreed.option.expertContamIntensity: Lower clamp on the plague intensity before it is used as a reciprocal for gap scaling.
lethalbreed.option.expertContamTimeScale: Lower clamp on the dev plague time-compression factor, to avoid dividing by zero in the timers.
lethalbreed.option.packEnabled.desc: Master switch. Off, no pack is ever formed and the per-zombie decision returns immediately.
lethalbreed.option.packCohesionRadius.de: A loose zombie joins a pack whose centroid is within this many blocks.
lethalbreed.option.packBreakRadius.desc: A member drifting beyond this from its pack centroid starts accruing stray activations. Kept well above the cohesion radius so a zombie walking around a wall does not lose its pack.
lethalbreed.option.packFormMinSize.desc: Zombies needed in the neighbourhood before a brand-new pack forms out of nothing.
lethalbreed.option.packMinSize.desc: Below this total membership a pack dissolves, after the grace period.
lethalbreed.option.packMaxSize.desc: Hard cap on members. Also caps a Necromancer's summoning while it is in a pack.
lethalbreed.option.packMinNeighbours.des: Neighbours needed before a lone zombie even considers a pack. This is the “nobody around, so it is pointless” short-circuit.
Consecutive out-of-range activations before a member actually leaves. Pure hysteresis.
lethalbreed.option.packDecisionDivisor.d: A zombie takes a pack decision one activation out of this many. The main CPU dial.
lethalbreed.option.packScanCap.desc: Maximum neighbours inspected per decision. Bounds the cost in a dense horde.
lethalbreed.option.packsPerTick.desc: Packs visited per server tick, round-robin: centroid, merge probe, dissolve check.
lethalbreed.option.packMergeRadius.desc: Two pack centroids closer than this are merge candidates.
lethalbreed.option.packMergeHeadingDot.d: Minimum agreement between the two headings for a merge, from -1 to 1. Without it, packs crossing in opposite directions still fuse and the whole population collapses into one mass.
lethalbreed.option.packDissolveGraceTick: How long a pack may stay under the minimum size before it is dissolved.
Off, packs form and stay cohesive but never pick a destination.
lethalbreed.option.packVirtualSpeed.desc: Blocks per tick for a pack simulated coarsely, out of view. Below walking speed, to pay back the terrain detours a straight line never takes.
lethalbreed.option.packLegMin.desc: Shortest leg of the migration random walk, in blocks.
lethalbreed.option.packLegMax.desc: Longest leg of the migration random walk, in blocks.
lethalbreed.option.packTurnDegrees.desc: Maximum heading change per leg. 0 gives a dead straight line forever. Bounding it is what makes the path read as a migration rather than as aimless wandering.
lethalbreed.option.packDwellTicks.desc: Pause on arrival before choosing the next destination.
Random spread applied to the dwell, so packs do not all move in lockstep.
lethalbreed.option.packArriveDistance.de: How close the pack centroid must get to count as arrived.
lethalbreed.option.packMarchLead.desc: Distance ahead of the centroid where the shared march waypoint is planted. Load-bearing: a lead beyond the LOD tiers would freeze marching members instead of moving them.
Activations a pack may make no headway before it gives up and picks a new destination. This is how walking around an obstacle degrades when there is simply no path.
lethalbreed.option.packMigrateAtDay.desc: Let packs keep migrating in daylight. Off by default: day-sleep wins, so packs travel by night and do not burn under the sun below the immunity phase.
lethalbreed.option.packVirtualEnabled.de: Dematerialise packs nobody can see and restore them on approach. Has its own switch because it is the only part of the system that creates and destroys entities; turning it off leaves packs fully materialised, which simply costs more.
lethalbreed.option.packMaterializeInterv: Ticks between two materialisation sweeps. Each sweep costs one position check per pack, not per zombie.
lethalbreed.option.packDematGraceTicks.d: How long a pack must be out of the entity-ticking area before it is dematerialised. A grace period rather than a timer: chunk unloading has been measured at anywhere from 2 to over 1200 ticks, so one observation proves nothing.
lethalbreed.option.packSpawnSpread.desc: Radius over which a re-materialised pack is scattered, so it does not reappear stacked in one column.
lethalbreed.option.packMaterializeRetrie: How many sweeps a dematerialised member may fail to come back before the pack gives up on it.
lethalbreed.option.packRejoinRadius.desc: How far from its pack a member returning from disk may be and still re-join it.
